rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Jeikin is an accessibility compliance tool that integrates with AI coding assistants via MCP to identify, track, and verify fixes for accessibility issues. It checks code against WCAG, EAA, ADA, and UK Equality Act standards, providing automated quality gates and audit documentation. Findings and verifications are accessible through any MCP-compatible client.
